label: Magicshine Controls
description: Control supported Magicshine lights from the Karoo app or the in-ride field, with lamp selection, quick beam switching, and battery and temperature telemetry.
releaseNotes:
* Hardened app CONNECT recovery from stale found/disconnected states
* Added short multi-attempt BLE reconnect after transient GATT failures
* Avoided unnecessary reconnect work when already connected
